research_dossier.central_question: How did five US Navy bombers and their rescue plane vanish without leaving a single trace of wreckage?
research_dossier.context: On December 5, 1945, five TBM Avenger torpedo bombers took off from Fort Lauderdale on a routine navigation exercise over the Atlantic.

chronology.event: Flight 19 departs Fort Lauderdale Naval Air Station with 14 airmen.
Flight leader Charles Taylor radios that his compasses failed and the ocean looked unfamiliar.
A Martin Mariner flying boat launches on a rescue mission and disappears within twenty minutes.
Massive naval search covering 250,000 square miles recovers zero debris or life rafts.

verified_claims.statement: All fourteen airmen and five Avenger bombers vanished without a single piece of wreckage ever being recovered.
verified_claims.evidence: US Navy Board of Inquiry official report, 1946.

verified_claims.statement: Flight leader Charles Taylor reported both aircraft compasses had simultaneously malfunctioned over open water.
verified_claims.evidence: Recorded radio transcripts preserved at the National Archives.

verified_claims.statement: The search-and-rescue Martin Mariner flying boat carrying thirteen crew members vanished twenty minutes after takeoff.
verified_claims.evidence: SS Gaines Mills merchant ship log reporting mid-air explosion.

uncertainties: Exact ditching coordinates and location of seafloor wreckage remain unknown.
unanswered_questions: Where did the Avengers run out of fuel along the Atlantic continental shelf?
research_dossier.notes_for_scriptwriter: Focus on documented radio transcripts and the strange loss of the rescue plane.

hook_candidates.text: In 1945, an intact ship sailed alone with dinner still warm on the table.
Seventy-two seconds of signal changed how astronomers scanned the sky forever.
The radar alarm tripped at midnight, pointing toward an empty patch of ocean.
The deepest vault on Earth held fifty records, but zero visitors were allowed inside.
A three-man crew vanished from an island lighthouse without leaving a single trace.
Deep below the Mediterranean floor lies an intact temple no diver was meant to see.
Astronomers logged the exact frequency, yet forty-nine years later the source remains completely silent.
Over twenty miles of ancient stone sat buried beneath coastal sand for a millennium.

lines.text: In 1945, five military bombers and their rescue plane vanished without leaving a trace.
lines.caps: FIVE *BOMBERS | RESCUE PLANE *VANISHED WITHOUT A TRACE

lines.text: Flight 19 took off from Florida for a routine naval navigation drill over the Atlantic.
lines.caps: FLIGHT 19 *TOOK OFF | ROUTINE *NAVIGATION DRILL OVER ATLANTIC

lines.text: Ninety minutes into the flight, the patrol leader radioed that both cockpit compasses were spinning wildly.
As daylight faded, radio transmissions grew faint while the pilots flew deeper into stormy waters.
lines.caps: RADIO GREW *FAINT | FLEW DEEPER INTO *STORMY WATERS

lines.text: A massive rescue aircraft was dispatched immediately to locate the squadron.
Within twenty minutes, that thirteen-man rescue flying boat also vanished from radar screens forever.
lines.caps: RESCUE FLYING BOAT *VANISHED | FROM RADAR SCREENS *FOREVER

lines.text: A four-day search across two hundred and fifty thousand square miles recovered zero oil slicks, life rafts, or aircraft wreckage.
lines.caps: MASSIVE SEARCH *RECOVERED | ZERO OIL SLICKS OR *AIRCRAFT WRECKAGE

lines.text: Eighty years later, the ocean floor still hides every trace of Flight 19.
lines.caps: EIGHTY YEARS *LATER | OCEAN STILL HIDES *EVERY TRACE
